lossy_evidence_warning: Full-frame PNGs decode existing accepted/Q1 MP4 review videos, not the raw full-frame arrays used for numerical gates. Codec differences confound tiny edge/color differences. Saved raw generated-face hashes are bound in the source review but were not a substitute for actual image inspection.

observations.mouth_teeth: Both arms show matching broad opening/closing shapes. Frames 15 and 183 show an open mouth with the upper tooth row in the same place; frame 120 has a conspicuously simplified bright central tooth patch in both arms. At frame 125 both show the same small rounded opening. Fine lip and tooth boundaries look soft in both; no new gross displaced/doubled tooth row was visible in Q1.
observations.chin_beard: The short-beard outline, gray chin hairs and neckline remain in corresponding positions in all six sampled pairs. No obvious new cut seam, detached beard patch or gross chin elongation was visible at frame 183, the selected largest reported chin-error frame.
observations.identity_context: Hairline, eyes, nose, shoulders and background align between paired images. No visible identity change in these stills.
observations.uncertainty: Very small local lip/beard edge differences may be present, but these lossy video decodes do not support attributing them to TensorRT instead of encoding. This is not a bit-exact visual claim.
